title: Aliveville — AI civilization simulation game in the browser
description: Play an AI civilization simulation in the browser: a 3D town of autonomous agents that live, remember, and react. No install. Free to try.
summary: Paused AI world experiment with autonomous villagers. Hosted game offline; source available to run locally.

text.atmospheric_background_video_showing_the: Atmospheric background video showing the town of Ashment with shifting lantern light and shadow.
text.a_paused_experiment_a_3d_town: A paused experiment: a 3D town where 5 AI agents live their own day, remember people, hold grudges, and gossip. The live game server is offline.
text.npcs_pull_from_location_aware_memory: NPCs pull from location-aware memory. They only recall what fits their current context and who they know.
text.the_agents_keep_going_after_you: The agents keep going after you close the tab. The world ages on its own.
text.tension_that_shifts_as_you_play: Tension that shifts as you play.
text.import_a_world_as_json_and: Import a world as JSON and turn it into something playable.
text.move_with_wasd_through_a_3d: Move with WASD through a 3D world with live lighting and atmosphere.
text.runs_in_your_browser_no_install: Runs in your browser, no install
text.a_3d_town_full_of_villagers: A 3D town full of villagers who run their own lives. They remember you, hold grudges, and talk about you behind your back. This is a paused experiment: the hosted game is offline, and the source is public.
text.hosted_game_offline_run_it_locally: Hosted game offline · run it locally from source
text.the_village_keeps_moving_once_you: The village keeps moving once you're in.
text.access_ashment_opens_the_simulation_but: Access Ashment opens the simulation, but the point is what happens after: agents keep their schedules, relationships, and memories in sync, and a director nudges things forward when it gets quiet.
text.npcs_with_their_own_secrets_and: NPCs with their own secrets and trust they earn or lose.
text.local_retrieval_shapes_what_they_say: Local retrieval shapes what they say and do.
text.a_director_nudges_things_forward_when: A director nudges things forward when the world goes quiet.
text.aliveville_is_a_browser_playable_ai: Aliveville is a browser-playable AI world simulator where five autonomous AI agents live their own daily lives in a 3D town. They remember people, hold grudges, and gossip while you explore. No install is required — it runs directly in modern web browsers.
text.yes_aliveville_is_free_to_play: Yes, Aliveville is free to play. It runs in your browser with no install required. You can walk the 3D town using WASD controls and interact with autonomous AI villagers immediately, with no download, account, or payment needed to start exploring.
text.do_the_ai_agents_in_aliveville: Do the AI agents in Aliveville have memory?
text.yes_npcs_use_location_aware_memory: Yes, NPCs use location-aware memory retrieval. They only recall what is relevant to their current context, state, and social bonds. Autonomous loops continue even when you are away, so agents keep living, remembering, and evolving their relationships over time.
text.can_i_play_aliveville_right_now: Can I play Aliveville right now?
text.not_right_now_aliveville_is_a: Not right now. Aliveville is a paused experiment and the hosted game server was shut down on 2026-09-26. It was built to run in the browser with no install; the source is public on GitHub if you want to run it yourself.
text.how_does_the_ai_world_simulation: How does the AI world simulation work?
text.agents_keep_their_schedules_relationship: Agents keep their schedules, relationships, memories, and narrative pressure in sync. The world ticks forward autonomously, aging and evolving even when no one is watching. A director nudges things forward when the world goes quiet, so the simulation never stalls.
text.what_can_i_do_in_aliveville: What can I do in Aliveville?
text.pick_a_hero_walk_the_3d: Pick a hero, walk the 3D town with WASD controls, and observe autonomous villagers going about their daily lives. You can watch social dynamics like grudges and gossip unfold in real time, and click to talk with the AI agents as you explore.
text.yes_aliveville_is_a_persistent_ecosystem: Yes, Aliveville is a persistent ecosystem exploring autonomous agent behavior, narrative emergence, and playable 3D exploration. It is an interactive AI world experiment where five agents live, remember, and react on their own, building emergent stories you can witness firsthand.
